Dumalneg National High School - Phased Delivery Pipeline, 16-Sprint WBS & Risk Matrix

g.text: 1. SIX-PHASE AGILE DELIVERY ROADMAP & ARCHITECTURAL PIPELINE
2. WORK BREAKDOWN STRUCTURE (WBS) & DELIVERABLES MATRIX (16 SPRINTS)
npm workspaces (student, teacher, admin, it-support) on dedicated ports
All 4 sub-applications compile in parallel with zero TypeScript errors.
Tailwind v4 tokens: Navy #002060, Gold #F59E0B, 4px-6px radius, zero emojis
Formal institutional look: buttons, cards, inputs, and modals validated.
[ DONE ] Zero-emoji standard enforced across design system.
Email/password registration with 60-second cooldown OTP token modal
Auto-advance numeric inputs, token resend timer, and 1-account-per-email.
[ DONE ] Cross-role collision error trapping verified.
DepEd Basic Ed Form (Revised 06/01/2025): LRN, PSA, Isnag, 4Ps, Tracks
Draft autosaving to LocalStorage ensures zero data loss during disconnects.
[ DONE ] Multi-step state machine fully operational.
Canvas Image Compressor & PDF Slip Engine
Client-side 1600px scaling to < 350KB; offline pdf-lib enrollment certificate
8MB mobile camera uploads reduced to 250KB; instant offline PDF generation.
[ DONE ] DepEd seal & School ID 300017 formatted.
Protected layout, live enrollment counters (Pending, Approved, Revision)
Real-time Supabase subscription reflects newly submitted student records.
[ DONE ] Live metrics and intake switch active.
Virtualized scrolling, debounced search across Name/LRN, multi-tier filters
Filter by Grade (7-12), Status, Strand; instantaneous client query execution.
Split screen document viewer, structured deficiency notes, section lock
Strict DepEd 40-cap quota enforces lock upon reaching capacity limit.
[ DONE ] Over-enrollment hard-blocked at database layer.
5-day (Mon-Fri) x 10-hour (07:00-17:00) interactive grid with category colors
Interactive slot creation modal assigns section, subject, teacher, and room.
[ DONE ] Grid rendering & time block calculation operational.
Flags Teacher double-booking, Classroom clash, and Section cohort collision.
[ DONE ] Red highlight & blocking alert active.
Personal schedule matrix, current class pill, advisory learner directory
Faculty view own teaching schedule; advisory class attendance sheet export.
Zero hardcoded dates: School Year, Trimesters 1-3, and intake window control
Modifying dates in IT console instantly updates admission banners globally.
Staff email onboarding tokens, classroom seating capacities, audit viewer
Staff onboarding invitation links route to designated portals with role gates.
4.5:1 contrast verification, full keyboard navigation, ARIA tags, system fonts
Lighthouse accessibility score > 95; zero broken color contrasts.
Network throttling (Slow 3G 400Kbps); draft recovery during cellular drops
Zero lost input fields during simulated disconnects; graceful error toasts.
Bundle optimization (< 180KB chunks), Vercel production rewrites, Git push
Clean deployment on Vercel; stakeholder sign-off with Dumalneg NHS team.
CRITICAL RISK MITIGATION & RESILIENCE STRATEGY (DUMALNEG FIELD CONDITIONS)
In-browser HTML5 canvas downscaling to < 350KB before transmission; LocalStorage draft persistence
Strict DepEd maximum cap of 40 learners enforced at database and UI layer; automatic section lock
Deconfliction engine calculates (A_start < B_end && A_end > B_start) across Teacher, Room, and Section
Locked backend architecture; frontend consuming immutable Supabase tables with zero migration risks
Strict path isolation (/admin, /teacher, /it-support, /) cleanly rewritten in root Next.js reverse-proxy
npm run build succeeds without warnings
Zero ESLint errors or unhandled promises
Displayed on all portals & PDF slips
Zero hardcoded dates; IT Support switches
Zero leftover build artifacts or loose files
